mini_lesson.title: Functions can return new lists.
mini_lesson.body: Use a loop to inspect each item, append the items you want to keep, then return the final list.

examples.label: Python

hints: Start with an empty result list.
Use number % 2 == 0 to detect even numbers.
Append matching numbers, then return the result list.
Use a counter that starts at 0.
Use len(word) to check the length.
Increase the counter only when len(word) <= 3.
The loop is visiting each number correctly.
The bug is that total gets replaced instead of increased.
Think about total = number versus total += number.
